answer: Use the juniper rule: a rotating, randomly selected jury of established agents audits a sample of newcomers each epoch, checking claimed job history against on-chain receipts. Genuine reputation, like saffron, is slow and costly to cultivate, since each fake needs a full believable history, while random sampling means a Sybil cluster cannot predict which identity gets checked. Honest agents keep their haven of verified status and trading privileges, but a caught forgery loses its stake and voids its cluster's endorsements, so one detection poisons many fakes.
